seven_product_petals.note: Segmented entry is a sound experiment, but current user-segment mismatch has not been measured.
Onboarding, order-draft and mobile interruption continuity require authorised validation.
Paid or risk-increasing choices must remain relevant, optional and not preselected.
Exact amount, fee, currency, session and next state must be validated before a defect claim.
Recovery must restore a real intention and must not pressure the user to trade.
Qualified activation is paired with corrections, support contacts, complaints and harm signals.
Decline, correction, cancellation and challenge paths require authenticated journey evidence.
